    integer, pointer :: arr(:) => null()
  contains

    procedure :: release => release_bit
    procedure :: clear => clear
    procedure :: add => get_addition
    procedure :: sum => get_summation
    procedure :: range => get_partial_summation
    procedure :: val => get_value
    procedure :: lower_bound => get_lower_bound
    procedure :: update => get_updated
    procedure :: max => get_maximum
  end type t_fenwick_tree
contains

    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(inout) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    integer :: p
    p = 1
    this%n = n
    allocate(this%arr(n))
    this%arr = 0
    do while (lshift(p,1) <= n)
      p = lshift(p,1)
    end do
    this%p = p
  end
  subroutine release_bit(this)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(inout) :: this
    if (associated(this%arr)) deallocate(this%arr)
  end
  subroutine clear(this)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(inout) :: this
    this%arr = 0
  end
  subroutine get_addition(this,i,v)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(inout) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, intent(in) :: v
    integer :: x
    x = i
    do while (x <= this%n)
      this%arr(x) = this%arr(x)+v
      x = x+and(x,-x)
    end do
  end
  function get_summation(this,i) result(s)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer :: x
    integer :: s
    s = -1
    if (i > this%n) return
    s = 0
    x = i
    do while (x > 0)
      s = s+this%arr(x)
      x = x-and(x,-x)
    end do
  end
  function get_partial_summation(this,l,r) result(s)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: l, r
    integer :: i, j
    integer :: s
    s = -1
    if (l > r) return
    s = 0
    i = l-1

program cartesian_coodinate
  use mod_fenwick_tree
  implicit none
  real(8), parameter :: tol = 1.e-10, inf = 1.e8
  integer :: n, i
  real(8) :: a(40000) = 0.d0, b(40000) = 0.d0, c(40000) = 0.d0
  character(64) :: x, y
  read(*,*) n
  do i = 1, n
    read(*,*) a(i), b(i), c(i)
  end do
  write(x,'(f32.16)') solve(a(1:n),b(1:n),c(1:n))
  write(y,'(f32.16)') solve(b(1:n),a(1:n),c(1:n))
  write(*,'(a,x,a)') trim(adjustl(x)), trim(adjustl(y))
contains
  function solve(a,b,c) result(l)
    type(t_fenwick_tree) :: bit
    real(8), intent(in) :: a(:), b(:), c(:)
    real(8) :: l, r, m, p(size(a),3)
    integer :: n, i, h(size(a)), inv
    l = -inf
    r = inf
    p = 0.d0
    n = size(a)
    call bit%init(n)
    do while (r-l > tol*max(1.d0,abs(l)))
      m = 0.5d0*(l+r)
      p(:,1) = (c-a*m)/b
      p(:,2) = -a/b
      call merge_sort(p(:,1:2))
      do i = 1, n
        p(i,3) = real(i,8)
      end do
      call merge_sort(p(:,2:3))
      h = nint(p(:,3))
      inv = 0
      call bit%clear()
      do i = 1, n
        inv = inv+bit%sum(h(i))
        call bit%add(h(i),1)
      end do
      if (n*(n-1)/2 <= 2*inv) then
        r = m
      else
        l = m
      end if
    end do
  end
  subroutine merge_sort(c)
    real(8), intent(inout) :: c(:,:)
    integer :: n, m, l, u, i
    n = size(c(:,1))
    m = n
    l = 1
    do while (m > 1)
      do i = 1, m/2
        u = min(2*i*l,n)
        call merger(c(2*(i-1)*l+1:(2*i-1)*l,:),c((2*i-1)*l+1:u,:))
      end do
      l = 2*l
      m = (m+1)/2
    end do
  end
  subroutine merger(c1,c2)
    real(8), intent(inout) :: c1(:,:), c2(:,:)
    real(8) :: c(size(c1(:,1))+size(c2(:,1)),size(c1(1,:)))
    integer :: i1, i2, n1, n2, i, n
    logical :: ok
    i1 = 1
    i2 = 1
    n1 = size(c1(:,1))
    n2 = size(c2(:,1))
    n = size(c1(1,:))
    do while (i1 <= n1 .and. i2 <= n2)
      ok = .false.
      do i = 1, n-1
        if (c1(i1,i) < c2(i2,i)) then
          ok = .true.
          exit
        end if
      end do
      if (.not.ok .and. c1(i1,n) == c2(i2,n)) ok = .true.
      if (ok) then
        c(i1+i2-1,:) = c1(i1,:)
        i1 = i1+1
      else
        c(i1+i2-1,:) = c2(i2,:)
        i2 = i2+1
      end if
    end do
    if (i1 <= n1) then
      c(i1+i2-1:n1+n2,:) = c1(i1:n1,:)
    else if (i2 <= n2) then
      c(i1+i2-1:n1+n2,:) = c2(i2:n2,:)
    end if
    c1 = c(1:n1,:)
    c2 = c(n1+1:n1+n2,:)
  end
end program cartesian_coodinate

    integer, intent(in) :: l, r

    real(8), intent(in) :: a(:), b(:), c(:)
    real(8) :: l, r, m, p(size(a),3)
    integer :: n, i, h(size(a)), inv
    l = -inf
    r = inf
    p = 0.d0
    n = size(a)
    call bit%init(n)
    do while (r-l > tol)
      m = 0.5d0*(l+r)
      p(:,1) = (c-a*m)/b
      p(:,2) = -a/b
      call merge_sort(p(:,1:2))
      do i = 1, n
        p(i,3) = real(i,8)
      end do
      call merge_sort(p(:,2:3))
      h = nint(p(:,3))
      inv = 0
      call bit%clear()
      do i = 1, n
        inv = inv+bit%sum(h(i))
        call bit%add(h(i),1)
      end do
      if (n*(n-1)/2 <= 2*inv) then
        r = m
      else
        l = m
      end if
    end do
  end
  subroutine merge_sort(c)
    real(8), intent(inout) :: c(:,:)
    integer :: n, m, l, u, i
    n = size(c(:,1))
    m = n
    l = 1
    do while (m > 1)
      do i = 1, m/2
        u = min(2*i*l,n)
        call merger(c(2*(i-1)*l+1:(2*i-1)*l,:),c((2*i-1)*l+1:u,:))
      end do
      l = 2*l
      m = (m+1)/2
    end do

    n1 = size(c1(:,1))
    n2 = size(c2(:,1))
    n = size(c1(1,:))
    do while (i1 <= n1 .and. i2 <= n2)
      ok = .false.
      do i = 1, n-1
        if (c1(i1,i) < c2(i2,i)) then
          ok = .true.
          exit

      end do
      if (.not.ok .and. c1(i1,n) == c2(i2,n)) ok = .true.

        i2 = i2+1

    else if (i2 <= n2) then

module mod_fenwick_tree
  implicit none
  type t_fenwick_tree
    private
    integer :: n, p
    integer, pointer :: arr(:) => null()
  contains
    procedure :: init => init_bit
    procedure :: release => release_bit
    procedure :: add => get_addition
    procedure :: sum => get_summation
    procedure :: range => get_partial_summation
    procedure :: val => get_value
    procedure :: lower_bound => get_lower_bound
    procedure :: update => get_updated
    procedure :: max => get_maximum
  end type t_fenwick_tree
contains
  subroutine init_bit(this,n)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(inout) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    integer :: p
    p = 1
    this%n = n
    allocate(this%arr(n))
    this%arr = 0
    do while (lshift(p,1) <= n)
      p = lshift(p,1)
    end do
    this%p = p
  end
  subroutine release_bit(this)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(inout) :: this
    if (associated(this%arr)) deallocate(this%arr)
  end
  subroutine get_addition(this,i,v)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(inout) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, intent(in) :: v
    integer :: x
    x = i
    do while (x <= this%n)
      this%arr(x) = this%arr(x)+v
      x = x+and(x,-x)
    end do
  end
  function get_summation(this,i) result(s)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer :: x
    integer :: s
    s = -1
    if (i > this%n) return
    s = 0
    x = i
    do while (x > 0)
      s = s+this%arr(x)
      x = x-and(x,-x)
    end do
  end
  function get_partial_summation(this,l,r) result(s)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: l, r
    integer :: i, j
    integer :: s
    s = -1
    if (l > r) return
    s = 0
    i = l-1
    j = r
    do while (j > i)
      s = s+this%arr(j)
      j = j-and(j,-j)
    end do
    do while (i > j)
      s = s-this%arr(i)
      i = i-and(i,-i)
    end do
  end
  function get_value(this,i) result(v)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer :: x
    integer :: v
    v = get_partial_summation(this,i,i)
  end
  function get_lower_bound(this,v) result(x)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: v
    integer :: x, k
    integer :: w
    x = 0
    if (v <= 0) return
    k = this%p
    w = v
    do while (k > 0)
      if (x+k <= this%n .and. this%arr(x+k) < w) then
        w = w-this%arr(x+k)
        x = x+k
      end if
      k = rshift(k,1)
    end do
    x = x+1
  end
  subroutine get_updated(this,i,v)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(inout) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer, intent(in) :: v
    integer :: x
    x = i
    do while (x <= this%n)
      if (this%arr(x) < v) this%arr(x) = v
      x = x+and(x,-x)
    end do
  end
  function get_maximum(this,i) result(m)
    class(t_fenwick_tree), intent(in) :: this
    integer, intent(in) :: i
    integer :: x, m
    x = i
    m = 0
    do while (x > 0)
      m = max(m,this%arr(x))
      x = x-and(x,-x)
    end do
  end
  function len_of_lis(a) result(m)
    integer, intent(in) :: a(:)
    type(t_fenwick_tree) :: bit
    integer :: m, n, i, t
    n = size(a)
    call init_bit(bit,n)
    m = 0
    do i = 1, n
      t = get_maximum(bit,a(i)-1)+1
      m = max(m,t)
      call get_updated(bit,a(i),t)
    end do
  end
  function inv_num(a) result(m)
    integer, intent(in) :: a(:)
    type(t_fenwick_tree) :: bit
    integer :: m, n, i, t
    n = size(a)
    call init_bit(bit,n)
    m = 0
    do i = 1, n
      call get_addition(bit,a(i),1)
      m = m+i-get_summation(bit,a(i))
    end do
  end
end module mod_fenwick_tree

class BIT
    def initialize(n)
        @n = n+1
        @dat = Array.new(@n+1, 0)
    end

    def sum(i)
        s = 0
        while i >= 0 do
            s += @dat[i]
            i = (i & (i + 1)) - 1
        end
        s
    end

    def add(i, x)
        while i <= @n do
            @dat[i] += x
            i |= i + 1
        end
    end
end

def inversion(arr)
    bit = BIT.new(arr.length)
    ret = 0
    arr.length.times do |i|
        ret += i - bit.sum(arr[i])
        bit.add(arr[i], 1)
    end
    ret
end

#{{{ SegmentTree: initSegmentTree[D](n:int, f:(D,D)->D, D0:D)
type SegmentTree[D] = object
  sz:int
  data:seq[D]
  D0:D
  f:(D,D)->D

proc initSegmentTree[D](n:int,f:(D,D)->D,D0:D):SegmentTree[D] =
  var sz = 1
  while sz < n: sz *= 2
  return SegmentTree[D](sz:sz,data:newSeqWith(sz*2,D0),D0:D0,f:f)

# preset and build {{{
proc preset[D](self:var SegmentTree[D], k:int, x:D) =
  self.data[k + self.sz] = x

proc build[D](self:var SegmentTree[D]) =
  for k in countdown(self.sz-1,1):
    self.data[k] = self.f(self.data[2 * k + 0], self.data[2 * k + 1]);

proc build[D](self:var SegmentTree[D], v:seq[D]) =
  for i in 0..<self.sz:
    self.data[i + self.sz] = if i < v.len: v[i] else: self.D0
  self.build()
# }}}

# recalc, update, [], []= {{{
proc recalc[D](self: var SegmentTree[D], k:int) =
  var k = k
  while true:
    k = (k shr 1)
    if k == 0: break
    self.data[k] = self.f(self.data[2 * k + 0], self.data[2 * k + 1])

proc update[D](self:var SegmentTree[D], k:int, x:D) =
  var k = k + self.sz
  self.data[k] = self.f(self.data[k], x)
  self.recalc(k)

proc `[]=`[D](self:var SegmentTree[D], k:int, x:D) =
  var k = k + self.sz
  self.data[k] = x
  self.recalc(k)

proc `[]`[D](self:SegmentTree[D],p:Slice[int]):D =
  var
    (L,R) = (self.D0, self.D0)
    (a,b) = (p.a + self.sz, p.b + 1 + self.sz)
  while a < b:
    if a mod 2 == 1: L = self.f(L, self.data[a]);a += 1
    if b mod 2 == 1: b -= 1;R = self.f(self.data[b], R)
    a = (a shr 1)
    b = (b shr 1)
  return self.f(L, R)

proc `[]`[D](self:SegmentTree[D],k:int):D = self.data[k + self.sz]
# }}}

# findFirst and findLast {{{
proc findSubtree[D](self:SegmentTree[D], a:int, check:(D)->bool, M: var D, t:int):int =
  var a = a
  while a < self.sz:
    var nxt = if t == 1: self.f(self.data[2 * a + t], M) else: self.f(M, self.data[2 * a + t])
    if check(nxt): a = 2 * a + t
    else: M = nxt; a = 2 * a + 1 - t
  return a - self.sz

# minimal x for which [a, x) is true (FFFFFFTTTTTT)
proc findFirst[D](self: SegmentTree[D], a:int, check:(D)->bool):int =
  var L = self.D0
  if a <= 0:
    if check(self.f(L, self.data[1])): return self.findSubtree(1, check, L, 0)
    return -1
  var a = a + self.sz
  var b = self.sz + self.sz
  while a < b:
    if (a and 1) > 0:
      let nxt = self.f(L, self.data[a])
      if check(nxt): return self.findSubtree(a, check, L, 0)
      L = nxt
      a += 1
    a = a shr 1;b = b shr 1
  return -1;

# minimal x for which [x, b) is true  (TTTTTTFFFFFFF)
proc findLast[D](self: SegmentTree[D], b:int, check:(D)->bool):int =
  var R = self.D0
  if b >= self.sz:
    if check(self.f(self.data[1], R)): return self.findSubtree(1, check, R, 1)
    return -1
  var a = 0 + self.sz
  var b = b + self.sz
  while a < b:
    if (b and 1) > 0:
      b -= 1
      let nxt = self.f(self.data[b], R)
      if check(nxt): return self.findSubtree(b, check, R, 1)
      R = nxt
    a = a shr 1;b = b shr 1
  return -1
#}}}

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.size = n
        self.tree = [0] * (n + 1)
        self.p = 2**(n.bit_length() - 1)
        self.dep = n.bit_length()
    def get(self, i):

        while i > 0:
            s += self.tree[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return s

            self.tree[i] += x
            i += i & -i

        s = 0
        k = self.p
        for _ in range(self.dep):

                s += k
                v -= self.tree[s+k]
            k //= 2
        return s + 1

        y = (f - d * x) / e

    for i in range(n - 1):

        c = ccc[i]
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            d = aaa[j]
            e = bbb[j]
            f = ccc[j]
            x, y = intersection(a, b, c, d, e, f)
            intersections_x[k] = x
            intersections_y[k] = y
            k += 1
    intersections_x.sort()
    intersections_y.sort()

    return intersections_x[(m - 1) // 2], intersections_y[(m - 1) // 2]

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.size = n
        self.tree = [0] * (n + 1)
        self.p = 2**(n.bit_length() - 1)
        self.dep = n.bit_length()
    def get(self, i):

        while i > 0:
            s += self.tree[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return s
 
    def add(self, i, x):

            self.tree[i] += x
            i += i & -i
    
    def bl(self, v):
        if v <= 0:
            return -1
        s = 0
        k = self.p
        for _ in range(self.dep):
            if s + k <= self.size and self.tree[s+k] < v:
                s += k
                v -= self.tree[s+k]
            k //= 2
        return s + 1
    
    def reset(self):
        self.tree = [0]*(self.size+1)

            i ^= i & -i

        inclines_y.append((bbb[i] / aaa[i], i))
    inclines_x.sort()
    inclines_y.sort()
    incline_rank_x = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)
    incline_rank_y = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)
    for k in range(n):
        incline_rank_x[inclines_x[k][1]] = n - k
        incline_rank_y[inclines_y[k][1]] = n - k

    def check_x(m):
        yyy = []

            k = incline_rank_x[i]

            k = incline_rank_y[i]
            intersection_left += bit_sum(bit, k)
            bit_add(bit, n + 1, k, 1)

        return intersection_left >= lim

    l = -2.0 * 10 ** 8
    r = 2.0 * 10 ** 8
    while r - l > 1e-9 and abs((r - l) / l if l != 0 else r) > 1e-9:
        m = (l + r) / 2

        m = (l + r) / 2
        if check_y(m):
            r = m
        else:
            l = m
    y = l

    return x, y

def solve(inp):
    def bit_add(arr, n, i, x):
        while i <= n:
            arr[i] += x
            i += i & -i

    def bit_sum(arr, i):
        result = 0
        while i > 0:
            result += arr[i]
            i ^= i & -i
        return result

    n = int(inp[0])
    lim = (n * (n - 1) // 2 + 1) // 2
    aaa = inp[1::3]
    bbb = inp[2::3]
    ccc = inp[3::3]

    inclines_x = []
    inclines_y = []
    for i in range(n):
        inclines_x.append((aaa[i] / bbb[i], i))
        inclines_y.append((bbb[i] / aaa[i], i))
    inclines_x.sort()
    inclines_y.sort()
    incline_rank_x = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)
    incline_rank_y = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)
    for k in range(n):
        incline_rank_x[inclines_x[k][1]] = n - k
        incline_rank_y[inclines_y[k][1]] = n - k

    def check_x(m):
        yyy = []
        for i in range(n):
            yyy.append(((ccc[i] - aaa[i] * m) / bbb[i], i))
        yyy.sort()

        bit = np.zeros(n + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        intersection_left = 0
        for j in range(n):
            i = yyy[j][1]
            k = incline_rank_x[i]
            intersection_left += bit_sum(bit, k)
            bit_add(bit, n + 1, k, 1)

        return intersection_left >= lim

    def check_y(m):
        xxx = []
        for i in range(n):
            xxx.append(((ccc[i] - bbb[i] * m) / aaa[i], i))
        xxx.sort()

        bit = np.zeros(n + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        intersection_left = 0
        for j in range(n):
            i = xxx[j][1]
            k = incline_rank_y[i]
            intersection_left += bit_sum(bit, k)
            bit_add(bit, n + 1, k, 1)

        return intersection_left >= lim

    l = -2.0 * 10 ** 8
    r = 2.0 * 10 ** 8
    while abs((r - l) / l) > 1e-9:
        m = (l + r) / 2
        if check_x(m):
            r = m
        else:
            l = m
    x = l

    l = -2.0 * 10 ** 8
    r = 2.0 * 10 ** 8
    while abs((r - l) / l) > 1e-9:
        m = (l + r) / 2
        if check_y(m):
            r = m
        else:
            l = m
    y = l

    return x, y

class BIT:
    #1-indexed
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.size = n
        self.tree = [0] * (n + 1)
        self.p = 2**(n.bit_length() - 1)
        self.dep = n.bit_length()
    def get(self, i):
        s = 0
        while i > 0:
            s += self.tree[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return s
 
    def add(self, i, x):
        while i <= self.size:
            self.tree[i] += x
            i += i & -i
    
    def bl(self, v):
        if v <= 0:
            return -1
        s = 0
        k = self.p
        for _ in range(self.dep):
            if s + k <= self.size and self.tree[s+k] < v:
                s += k
                v -= self.tree[s+k]
            k //= 2
        return s + 1

class Bit:
    # 参考1: http://hos.ac/slides/20140319_bit.pdf
    # 参考2: https://atcoder.jp/contests/arc046/submissions/6264201
    # 検証: https://atcoder.jp/contests/arc046/submissions/7435621
    # values の 0 番目は使わない
    # len(values) を 2 冪 +1 にすることで二分探索の条件を減らす
    def __init__(self, a):
        if hasattr(a, "__iter__"):
            le = len(a)
            self.n = 1 << le.bit_length()  # le を超える最小の 2 冪
            self.values = values = [0] * (self.n + 1)
            values[1:le + 1] = a[:]
            for i in range(1, self.n):
                values[i + (i & -i)] += values[i]
        elif isinstance(a, int):
            self.n = 1 << a.bit_length()
            self.values = [0] * (self.n + 1)
        else:
            raise TypeError

    def add(self, i, val):
        n, values = self.n, self.values
        while i <= n:
            values[i] += val
            i += i & -i

    def sum(self, i):  # (0, i]
        values = self.values
        res = 0
        while i > 0:
            res += values[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return res

    def bisect_left(self, v):  # self.sum(i) が v 以上になる最小の i
        n, values = self.n, self.values
        if v > values[n]:
            return None
        i, step = 0, n >> 1
        while step:
            if values[i + step] < v:
                i += step
                v -= values[i]
            step >>= 1
        return i + 1

def inversion_number(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    arr = sorted(range(n), key=lambda x: arr[x])
    bit = Bit(n)
    res = n * (n-1) >> 1
    for val in arr:
        res -= bit.sum(val+1)
        bit.add(val+1, 1)
    return res

        n, values = self.n, self.values
        if v > values[n]:
            return None
        i, step = 0, n >> 1
        while step:
            if values[i + step] < v:
                i += step
                v -= values[i]
            step >>= 1
        return i + 1

        res -= bit.sum(val+1)
        bit.add(val+1, 1)
    return res

def solve(inp):
    def intersection(a, b, c, d, e, f):
        if a == 0:
            y = c / b
            x = (f - e * y) / d
            return x, y
        if d == 0:
            y = f / e
            x = (c - b * y) / a
            return x, y
        if b == 0:
            x = c / a
            y = (f - d * x) / e
            return x, y
        if e == 0:
            x = f / d
            y = (c - a * x) / b
            return x, y
        x = (c * e - b * f) / (a * e - b * d)
        y = (f - d * x) / e
        return x, y

    n = inp[0]
    m = n * (n - 1) // 2
    aaa = inp[1::3].astype(np.float64)
    bbb = inp[2::3].astype(np.float64)
    ccc = inp[3::3].astype(np.float64)

    intersections_y = np.zeros(m, dtype=np.float64)
    k = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        a = aaa[i]
        b = bbb[i]
        c = ccc[i]
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            d = aaa[j]
            e = bbb[j]
            f = ccc[j]
            x, y = intersection(a, b, c, d, e, f)
            intersections_x[k] = x
            intersections_y[k] = y
            k += 1
    intersections_x.sort()
    intersections_y.sort()

    return intersections_x[(m - 1) // 2], intersections_y[(m - 1) // 2]

def solve(inp):
    def bit_add(arr, n, i, x):
        while i <= n:
            arr[i] += x
            i += i & -i

    def bit_sum(arr, i):
        result = 0
        while i > 0:
            result += arr[i]
            i ^= i & -i
        return result

    n = int(inp[0])
    lim = (n * (n - 1) // 2 + 1) // 2
    aaa = inp[1::3]
    bbb = inp[2::3]
    ccc = inp[3::3]

    inclines_x = [(aaa[i] / bbb[i], i) for i in range(n)]
    inclines_y = [(bbb[i] / aaa[i], i) for i in range(n)]
    inclines_x.sort()
    inclines_y.sort()
    incline_rank_x = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)
    incline_rank_y = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)
    for k in range(n):
        incline_rank_x[inclines_x[k][1]] = n - k
        incline_rank_y[inclines_y[k][1]] = n - k

    def check_x(m):
        yyy = [((ccc[i] - aaa[i] * m) / bbb[i], i) for i in range(n)]
        yyy.sort()

        bit = np.zeros(n + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        intersection_left = 0
        for j in range(n):
            i = yyy[j][1]
            k = incline_rank_x[i]
            intersection_left += bit_sum(bit, k)
            bit_add(bit, n + 1, k, 1)

        return intersection_left >= lim

    def check_y(m):
        xxx = [((ccc[i] - bbb[i] * m) / aaa[i], i) for i in range(n)]
        xxx.sort()

        bit = np.zeros(n + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        intersection_left = 0
        for j in range(n):
            i = xxx[j][1]
            k = incline_rank_y[i]
            intersection_left += bit_sum(bit, k)
            bit_add(bit, n + 1, k, 1)

        return intersection_left >= lim

    l = -2.0 * 10 ** 8
    r = 2.0 * 10 ** 8
    while r - l > 1e-9 and abs((r - l) / l if l != 0 else r) > 1e-9:
        m = (l + r) / 2
        if check_x(m):
            r = m
        else:
            l = m
    x = l

    l = -2.0 * 10 ** 8
    r = 2.0 * 10 ** 8
    while r - l > 1e-9 and abs((r - l) / l if l != 0 else r) > 1e-9:
        m = (l + r) / 2
        if check_y(m):
            r = m
        else:
            l = m
    y = l

    return x, y

def intersection(a, b, c, d, e, f):
    if a == 0:
        y = c / b
        x = (f - e * y) / d
        return x, y
    if d == 0:
        y = f / e
        x = (c - b * y) / a
        return x, y
    if b == 0:
        x = c / a
        y = (f - d * x) / e
        return x, y
    if e == 0:
        x = f / d
        y = (c - a * x) / b
        return x, y
    x = (c * e - b * f) / (a * e - b * d)
    y = (f - d * x) / e
    return x, y

class BIT:

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.size = n
        self.tree = [0] * (n + 1)
        self.p = 2**(n.bit_length() - 1)
        self.dep = n.bit_length()
    def get(self, i):
        s = 0
        while i > 0:
            s += self.tree[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return s
 
    def add(self, i, x):
        while i <= self.size:
            self.tree[i] += x
            i += i & -i
    
    def bl(self, v):
        if v <= 0:
            return -1
        s = 0
        k = self.p
        for _ in range(self.dep):
            if s + k <= self.size and self.tree[s+k] < v:
                s += k
                v -= self.tree[s+k]
            k //= 2
        return s + 1
    
    def reset(self):
        self.tree = [0]*(self.size+1)

def solve(inp):
    def intersection(a, b, c, d, e, f):
        if a == 0:
            y = c / b
            x = (f - e * y) / d
            return x, y
        if d == 0:
            y = f / e
            x = (c - b * y) / a
            return x, y
        if b == 0:
            x = c / a
            y = (f - d * x) / e
            return x, y
        if e == 0:
            x = f / d
            y = (c - a * x) / b
            return x, y
        x = (c * e - b * f) / (a * e - b * d)
        y = (f - d * x) / e
        return x, y

    n = inp[0]
    m = n * (n - 1) // 2
    aaa = inp[1::3]
    bbb = inp[2::3]
    ccc = inp[3::3]

    intersections_y = np.zeros(m, dtype=np.float64)
    k = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):

        b = bbb[i]

class Bit:
    # 参考1: http://hos.ac/slides/20140319_bit.pdf
    # 参考2: https://atcoder.jp/contests/arc046/submissions/6264201
    # 検証: https://atcoder.jp/contests/arc046/submissions/7435621
    # values の 0 番目は使わない
    # len(values) を 2 冪 +1 にすることで二分探索の条件を減らす
    def __init__(self, a):
        if hasattr(a, "__iter__"):
            le = len(a)
            self.n = 1 << le.bit_length()  # le を超える最小の 2 冪
            self.values = values = [0] * (self.n + 1)
            values[1:le + 1] = a[:]
            for i in range(1, self.n):
                values[i + (i & -i)] += values[i]
        elif isinstance(a, int):
            self.n = 1 << a.bit_length()
            self.values = [0] * (self.n + 1)
        else:
            raise TypeError

    def add(self, i, val):
        n, values = self.n, self.values
        while i <= n:
            values[i] += val
            i += i & -i

    def sum(self, i):  # (0, i]
        values = self.values
        res = 0
        while i > 0:
            res += values[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return res

    def bisect_left(self, v):  # self.sum(i) が v 以上になる最小の i
        n, values = self.n, self.values
        if v > values[n]:
            return None
        i, step = 0, n >> 1
        while step:
            if values[i + step] < v:
                i += step
                v -= values[i]
            step >>= 1
        return i + 1

    bit = Bit(n)
    res = n * (n-1) // 2
    for val in arr:
        res -= bit.sum(val+1)
        bit.add(val+1, 1)
    return res

def solve(inp):

        while i <= n:
            arr[i] += x
            i += i & -i

    def bit_sum(arr, i):
        result = 0
        while i > 0:
            result += arr[i]
            i ^= i & -i
        return result

    n = int(inp[0])
    lim = (n * (n - 1) // 2 + 1) // 2
    aaa = inp[1::3]
    bbb = inp[2::3]
    ccc = inp[3::3]

    inclines_x = []
    inclines_y = []
    for i in range(n):
        inclines_x.append((aaa[i] / bbb[i], i))
        inclines_y.append((bbb[i] / aaa[i], i))
    inclines_x.sort()
    inclines_y.sort()
    incline_rank_x = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)
    incline_rank_y = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)
    for k in range(n):
        incline_rank_x[inclines_x[k][1]] = n - k
        incline_rank_y[inclines_y[k][1]] = n - k

    def check_x(m):
        yyy = []
        for i in range(n):
            yyy.append(((ccc[i] - aaa[i] * m) / bbb[i], i))
        yyy.sort()

        bit = np.zeros(n + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        intersection_left = 0
        for j in range(n):
            i = yyy[j][1]
            k = incline_rank_x[i]
            intersection_left += bit_sum(bit, k)
            bit_add(bit, n + 1, k, 1)

        return intersection_left >= lim

    def check_y(m):
        xxx = []
        for i in range(n):
            xxx.append(((ccc[i] - bbb[i] * m) / aaa[i], i))
        xxx.sort()

        bit = np.zeros(n + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        intersection_left = 0
        for j in range(n):
            i = xxx[j][1]
            k = incline_rank_y[i]
            intersection_left += bit_sum(bit, k)
            bit_add(bit, n + 1, k, 1)

        return intersection_left >= lim

    l = -2.0 * 10 ** 8
    r = 2.0 * 10 ** 8
    while l + 1e-9 < r:
        m = (l + r) / 2
        if check_x(m):
            r = m
        else:
            l = m
    x = l

    l = -2.0 * 10 ** 8
    r = 2.0 * 10 ** 8
    while l + 1e-9 < r:
        m = (l + r) / 2
        if check_y(m):
            r = m
        else:
            l = m
    y = l

    return x, y

class Bit:
    # 参考1: http://hos.ac/slides/20140319_bit.pdf
    # 参考2: https://atcoder.jp/contests/arc046/submissions/6264201
    # 検証: https://atcoder.jp/contests/arc046/submissions/7435621
    # values の 0 番目は使わない
    # len(values) を 2 冪 +1 にすることで二分探索の条件を減らす
    def __init__(self, a):
        if hasattr(a, "__iter__"):
            le = len(a)
            self.n = 1 << le.bit_length()  # le を超える最小の 2 冪
            self.values = values = [0] * (self.n + 1)
            values[1:le + 1] = a[:]
            for i in range(1, self.n):
                values[i + (i & -i)] += values[i]
        elif isinstance(a, int):
            self.n = 1 << a.bit_length()
            self.values = [0] * (self.n + 1)
        else:
            raise TypeError

    def add(self, i, val):
        n, values = self.n, self.values
        while i <= n:
            values[i] += val
            i += i & -i

    def sum(self, i):  # (0, i]
        values = self.values
        res = 0
        while i > 0:
            res += values[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return res

    def bisect_left(self, v):  # self.sum(i) が v 以上になる最小の i
        n, values = self.n, self.values
        if v > values[n]:
            return None
        i, step = 0, n >> 1
        while step:
            if values[i + step] < v:
                i += step
                v -= values[i]
            step >>= 1
        return i + 1

def inversion_number(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    arr = sorted(range(n), key=lambda x: arr[x])
    bit = Bit(n)
    res = n * (n-1) >> 1
    for val in arr:
        res -= bit.sum(val+1)
        bit.add(val+1, 1)
    return res

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.size = n
        self.tree = [0] * (n + 1)
        self.p = 2**(n.bit_length() - 1)
        self.dep = n.bit_length()
    def get(self, i):
        s = 0
        while i > 0:
            s += self.tree[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return s

            self.tree[i] += x
            i += i & -i
    
    def bl(self, v):

        s = 0
        k = self.p
        for _ in range(self.dep):

                s += k
                v -= self.tree[s+k]
            k //= 2
        return s + 1

def solve(inp):

        if a * e - b * d == 0:
            print('WA')
            exit()

        c = ccc[i]

            d = aaa[j]

            intersections_x[k] = x
            intersections_y[k] = y

    intersections_x.sort()
    intersections_y.sort()

class Bit:
    # 参考1: http://hos.ac/slides/20140319_bit.pdf
    # 参考2: https://atcoder.jp/contests/arc046/submissions/6264201
    # 検証: https://atcoder.jp/contests/arc046/submissions/7435621
    # values の 0 番目は使わない
    # len(values) を 2 冪 +1 にすることで二分探索の条件を減らす
    def __init__(self, a):
        if hasattr(a, "__iter__"):
            le = len(a)
            self.n = 1 << le.bit_length()  # le を超える最小の 2 冪
            self.values = values = [0] * (self.n + 1)
            values[1:le + 1] = a[:]
            for i in range(1, self.n):
                values[i + (i & -i)] += values[i]
        elif isinstance(a, int):
            self.n = 1 << a.bit_length()
            self.values = [0] * (self.n + 1)
        else:
            raise TypeError

    def add(self, i, val):
        n, values = self.n, self.values
        while i <= n:
            values[i] += val
            i += i & -i

    def sum(self, i):  # (0, i]
        values = self.values
        res = 0
        while i > 0:
            res += values[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return res

    def bisect_left(self, v):  # self.sum(i) が v 以上になる最小の i
        n, values = self.n, self.values
        if v > values[n]:
            return None
        i, step = 0, n >> 1
        while step:
            if values[i + step] < v:
                i += step
                v -= values[i]
            step >>= 1
        return i + 1

    n = len(arr)
    arr = sorted(range(n), key=lambda x: arr[x])
    bit = Bit(n)
    res = n * (n-1) >> 1
    for val in arr:
        res -= bit.sum(val+1)
        bit.add(val+1, 1)
    return res

        self.N = N
        self.tree = [0] * (N + 1)

        x = a
        while x <= self.N:

            x += (x & -x)

            d = aaa[j]
            e = bbb[j]
            f = ccc[j]
            x, y = intersection(a, b, c, d, e, f)
            intersections_x[k] = x
            intersections_y[k] = y
            k += 1
    intersections_x.sort()
    intersections_y.sort()

class Bit:
    # 参考1: http://hos.ac/slides/20140319_bit.pdf
    # 参考2: https://atcoder.jp/contests/arc046/submissions/6264201
    # 検証: https://atcoder.jp/contests/arc046/submissions/7435621
    # values の 0 番目は使わない
    # len(values) を 2 冪 +1 にすることで二分探索の条件を減らす
    def __init__(self, a):
        if hasattr(a, "__iter__"):
            le = len(a)
            self.n = 1 << le.bit_length()  # le を超える最小の 2 冪
            self.values = values = [0] * (self.n + 1)
            values[1:le + 1] = a[:]
            for i in range(1, self.n):
                values[i + (i & -i)] += values[i]
        elif isinstance(a, int):
            self.n = 1 << a.bit_length()
            self.values = [0] * (self.n + 1)
        else:
            raise TypeError

    def add(self, i, val):
        n, values = self.n, self.values
        while i <= n:
            values[i] += val
            i += i & -i

    def sum(self, i):  # (0, i]
        values = self.values
        res = 0
        while i > 0:
            res += values[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return res

    def bisect_left(self, v):  # self.sum(i) が v 以上になる最小の i
        n, values = self.n, self.values
        if v > values[n]:
            return None
        i, step = 0, n >> 1
        while step:
            if values[i + step] < v:
                i += step
                v -= values[i]
            step >>= 1
        return i + 1

def inversion_number(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    arr = sorted(range(n), key=lambda x: arr[x])
    bit = Bit(n)
    res = n * (n-1) >> 1
    for val in arr:
        res -= bit.sum(val+1)
        bit.add(val+1, 1)
    return res

def addbit(i, x=1):
    i += 1
    while i <= N:
        BIT[i] += x
        i += i & (-i)
def getsum(i):
    ret = 0
    i += 1
    while i != 0:
        ret += BIT[i]
        i -= i&(-i)
    return ret
def bit(L):
    global BIT
    BIT=[0] * (N+1)
    re = 0
    for i, l in enumerate(L):
        re += i - getsum(l)
        addbit(l)
    return re
def calc(Z):

    for i in range(50):

        if bit(A) > N*(N-1)//4:
            l = m
        else:
            r = m
    return l
